regions.merged_text: God bless you Patrick Gainer. Many thanks for your favor of several weeks ago. Please pardon delay. I pray for your good will and for God's holy guidance in regard to the important step you have been considering. I am sure that if you go to the holy sacraments frequently and earnestly, God will not let you go astray.
